product.name: Workstream by Monoprice Easy Adjustable Full-Motion Gas-Spring 2-Segment Wall Mount for Monitors Up To 27in Max Weight 15.4lbs
product.description: This easy‑adjust monitor mount frees up space on your desktop by mounting your display on the wall instead of taking up space on your desk. The fully‑adjustable gas spring arm provides a wide range instant adjustments, similar to the desktop version. It works well with workstations that are next to a wall and also works for non‑traditional work spaces where there may not even be a real desk to support a monitor.This mount provides full adjustability for monitors, including vertical and horizontal tilt, height level adjustment, and portrait or landscape orientation rotation. The extra arm segment provides additional length and a wider range of screen position options.Features: Instant tilt, swivel, rotatation, and height adjustmentsThe wall mounted design frees up desk space and suits non‑traditional workstationsThe gas‑spring provides a counterbalance force that lets the monitor hover and allows for easy one‑handed adjustmentMade of high‑quality metal structural partsWorks with most monitors up to 27" and weighing up to 15.4 lbs.*Supports 75x75 and 100x100 VESA® patternsThe built‑in cable management system minimizes wire mess by routing the cables through the mount's arm segments*The minimum and maximum display sizes are only approximations. Your TV will work with this mount as long as it has a compatible VESA® pattern and maximum weight.
